summary: Iter 13 — Noxeal multi-language i18n via Claude (auto-translate + cache). Backend: 21/21 pytest passing in ~7s (test_iteration13_i18n.py) covering /api/articles/{slug}?lang=, /api/translate/strings (cache hit/miss/invalid/empty), listings with lang (cached-only — featured/articles/most-read), invalid-lang fallback, and full regression on Make.com POST, editorial/activity, post-reading, me/saved-sync, me/highlights, admin/webhook-logs. Frontend Playwright verified: ?lang=fr/en/nl URL hydration → html.lang + lang badge + nav words + hero h1 'Découvrez la vérité avant que l'algorithme ne la déforme' (real Claude output) ✅; localStorage persistence when URL has no lang param ✅; article translation banner + article-see-original ↔ article-back-translated toggle ✅; api.js interceptor injects lang=fr in /api/search GET ✅; banner NOT shown without lang param ✅. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: lang-switcher click while URL already contains ?lang= param does NOT switch language — see rca below.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking lang-switcher-button → lang-option-fr (or any other lang) does NOT switch language IF the current URL already contains a ?lang= query param. setLang() correctly updates localStorage, then window.location.reload() reloads — but detectInitial() reads URL ?lang= FIRST (before localStorage), so the old URL param wins on every reload. User sees nothing change. Works fine only when URL has no ?lang= param (e.g. direct visit to '/').

action_items: Optional UX: skip the soft reload entirely and propagate lang change via React state + i18n re-render (avoid full reload cost). All server fetches already use the api.js interceptor to inject lang, so a soft state change should be enough. This would also fix the URL-param bug as a side effect.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.js detectInitial precedence (URL > localStorage > navigator) is correct in spec terms (?lang= should override), but the switcher click flow is broken when URL has a stale ?lang= param — fix needs to keep them in sync.

server.py:377-417 GET /api/articles/{slug}?lang= correctly persists translations in db.articles.translations.{lang} via $set, returns lang+has_original, strips translations dict from response — clean.

server.py:420-464 POST /api/translate/strings handles empty/invalid/missing fields gracefully (returns input or [] with no exception); cache key (lang, src) in db.ui_translations is sensible. Cap of 200 strings × 500 chars is reasonable.

_apply_cached_translation in server.py is called on listings to apply ONLY cached translations (no fresh Claude calls) — verified: featured/articles/most-read return items with lang='es' for uncached entries and lang='en/fr/nl' for cached, never trigger fresh Claude → fast & cheap as designed.
Invalid lang ('xx') correctly falls back to es with has_original absent — verified by test_article_invalid_lang_fallbacks_to_spanish.

ai_service.translate_article(): translates title/excerpt/body/faqs/etc atomically. Cache stored once per (slug, lang). Translated body preserves HTML structure based on real article output observed in Playwright.
Make.com POST regression: still working with X-API-Key. Article creation respects publish:false → draft. No conflict with new lang logic.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 pytest, ~7s, includes article translation EN+FR with Claude live + cache hit verification + UI strings cache + listings cached-only + Make.com regression + post-reading + saved/sync + highlights + admin webhook-logs)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 7/8 critical i18n flows verified PASS. Failing flow: switcher click while URL already has ?lang= param (root caused, fix specified). All other UI behavior (URL hydration for ES/EN/FR/NL, hero h1 translation, footer translation when properly switched, article banner toggle ↔ see-original/back-translated, localStorage persistence without URL param, api.js interceptor lang injection in /api/search, no banner without lang param) works correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_i18n.py -v — 21 tests, ~7s when cache primed (12-18s first run for Claude article translation). Frontend testids: lang-switcher-button, lang-switcher-menu, lang-option-{es,en,fr,nl}, article-translation-banner, article-see-original, article-back-translated. Reproduce switcher bug: visit /?lang=es, click switcher, click FR — expect FR, get ES (URL param wins). Fix in LanguageSwitcher.jsx onClick: add `const url=new URL(window.location.href); url.searchParams.set('lang', l.code); window.history.replaceState({},'',url.toString());` BEFORE the setTimeout reload call. After fix, re-run Playwright TEST 4 and TEST 5 (footer FR) which depend on it.
